item.title: 2 students arrested for allegedly throwing objects at police during anti-ICE walkout in Mesa
item.description: Two junior high students who allegedly threw items at police during school walkouts protesting ICE in Mesa were arrested on Friday, authorities said.

item.description: NASHVILLE (AP) — A powerful storm bore down on the East Coast on Saturday, with forecasters warning of howling winds, flooding and heavy snow, including in some Southeast coastal communities more accustomed to hurricanes than blizzards.
